# HudGauge

Shows remaining capacity in segments, with a brief afterimage when the value drops.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="hud-gauge" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | Required | Gauge name |
| `value` | number | Required | Current value, clamped to 0–max; non-finite numbers count as 0 |
| `max` | number | 100 | Upper bound; invalid values fall back to 100 |

## Keyboard and usage notes

Read-only gauges use meter semantics, with "current / max" as the value text. At 50% or less it shows the warning color, at 20% or less the danger color; the number stays visible so color is never the only cue.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmHudGauge } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```

Copy the editable source:

```sh
pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/hud-gauge.json
```
